{{Quote|Lowlife scum has been hiding in my station, spreading counterfeit Republic credits.|Rozatta, owner of Outland Station|<ref name="BH" />}}
'''Obees Ramee''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Forger (profession)/Legends|counterfeiter]] with [[Color/Legends|orange]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]]<ref name="Prima" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="Prima" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> he was a member of the criminal [[Meeko Ghintee]]'s thugs who sold counterfeited [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Outland Transit Station|Outland Station]]. The owner of the station&mdash;the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Rozatta]]&mdash;placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Ramee's head for his crimes, offering 1,000 credits for his capture or 500 upon [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Prima" /> Ramee wore a gray [[Clothing|jacket]] over a red shirt with tan pants and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="BH" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
In 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Ramee practiced firing his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] at [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] targets in a shooting range on the station alongside another Gran and two [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] encountered Ramee and his training partners while pursuing Ghintee and captured the Gran alive while dispatching his comrades.<ref name="BH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Obees Ramee first appeared in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', developed by [[LucasArts]]. In the game, Ramee is the fifth optional bounty available to the player that can be captured alive for a higher sum of credits or killed for a lower amount.<ref name="BH" /> This article assumes that Jango Fett captured Ramee alive for the full sum of credits.
